author: TheTNTPotato
body:
https://avicus.net/TheTNTPotato#infractions

I don't expect my latest one to be removed, since I did use x-ray, so I won't talk about that too much. If you do remove it, that'd be lovely, but I don't expect that to happen. I haven't used it since, which is all that matters. I definitely learned from the ban, but I do understand that learning from it doesn't make it invalid.

Would like the kick to be removed, since I only reported Para once for something small (think it was for "pls" or something, don't remember). The staff used to do it all the time, and would even punish each other jokingly for things like that. Those days are gone now, so the infraction is no longer valid (never was in the first place tbh).

woo~

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

I apologize because you never received a reply.

The infraction for the temporary ban will not be removed. This infraction is still valid and will remain as a reminder of your past behaviour. I understand that you have learnt from the ban, but as you said, this still does not give a legitimate reason to remove it. 

The kick will be removed. The story is believable and since it was such a long time ago and seems so minuscule, it will be taken from your infraction page. 

Regards,
MidnightBeats
